decision: KerML 8.2.4.1.2 states SpecificType : Specialization : specific = [QualifiedName] | specific += OwnedFeatureChain { ownedRelatedElement += specific }. The definition line ends in ':' where '=' belongs; deviation SpecificType (follow_spec, citing KERML11-108) reads it as a definition, as the production is referenced from Specialization, Subsetting and Redefinition. The pilot Xtext has no SpecificType rule; it inlines the two alternatives. The body is unambiguous: a cross-reference, a ref to QualifiedName by convention, or an OwnedFeatureChain. The `{ ownedRelatedElement += specific }` action is abstract syntax.

evidence.note: SpecificType : Specialization : specific = [QualifiedName] | specific += OwnedFeatureChain { ownedRelatedElement += specific }
